metadata.description: An office of AI agent teams that work with you.

unavailable.web_search: Connect Anthropic in Models & costs to search the web.
unavailable.github_comment: Connect GitHub in Integrations to comment.
unavailable.request_help: Hire another team so the teams can help each other.
unavailable.ask_teammate: Works when the team has more than one person.

delivered.label: Deliveries · 7 days
delivered.hint: Deliveries approved in the last 7 days. The darkest bar is today.

firstPass.label: First pass
firstPass.hint: Of this week's deliveries, how many you approved without asking for changes.

timeSaved.label: Time saved
timeSaved.hint: How long a person would have taken to do this week's deliveries.

home.allClear: All caught up. Nothing is waiting on you.

alerts.deliveries: {count} {count, plural, one {delivery is} other {deliveries are}} waiting for your approval
alerts.tools: {count} {count, plural, one {agent is asking} other {agents are asking}} for permission to use a tool
alerts.handoff: {from} is waiting for an answer from {to}

home.teamStats: Deliveries in 7 days · approved on the first pass
home.activityEmpty: Once your teams start working, you can follow along here.

team.placeholder: What can the {team} team do for you?

columns.inProgressEmpty: When you make a request, it shows up here.

state.afterChanges: Approved after {count, plural, one {# round of changes} other {# rounds of changes}}
state.working: The team is working on it

team.openRequestHint: Describe what you need. {lead} reads it and picks who does what, in what order.

remove.label: Remove team
remove.question: Remove {team}?
remove.detail: Its people, room and every delivery are deleted. You can hire the team again later, starting fresh. This can't be undone.

room.label: Team room
room.mentionHintExample: Use @ to call someone in, like @{example}.
room.newMessages: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
room.leadAnswers: The team lead answers. Use @ to ask someone else, like @{example}.

delivery.inProgress: The team is still working. The text shows up here as soon as the first version is ready.
delivery.delivered: Delivered. {count, plural, =0 {Approved on the first pass.} one {Approved after # round of changes.} other {Approved after # rounds of changes.}}

manage.cancelDetail: The team stops working on it and it leaves the board. What was written so far stays on this page.
manage.deleteDetail: Its versions, notes and conversation are deleted too. This can't be undone.

delivery.liveNote: Live. The finished version appears here when the step is done.

decision.label: Your decision
decision.prompt: Like it? Approve it to deliver, or tell us what to change in your own words.
decision.whatToChange: What do you want to change?
decision.placeholder: E.g. make the intro shorter and add an example with an electricity bill
decision.relay: {name} passes it on to whoever did the part you want to change.

waiting.title: Waiting on you
waiting.count: {count, plural, one {# item needs} other {# items need}} your decision to move forward.
waiting.empty: Nothing is waiting on you right now.
waiting.checkpoint: {agent} wants your OK before the team goes on

requestForm.placeholder: Describe it the way you'd tell a colleague. E.g. an article about solar energy for homeowners, in a light tone.
requestForm.noTeams: Hire a team to make your first request.
requestForm.teamDecidesHint: Ask for anything in the team's area. The lead reads it and picks who does what.

outOfScope.title: That's outside what {team} does.
outOfScope.noTeam: No team in your office does this yet. You can hire one in Hire a team.

newRequest.title: New request
newRequest.intro: Describe what you need. We'll suggest the right team.
newRequest.placeholder: E.g. an article about solar energy for homeowners, light tone

hire.title: Hire a team
hire.intro: Every team arrives ready to go: people with clear roles and a way of working. You can adjust anything later.
hire.askManager: Ask whoever manages the office to hire it.

agent.costNote: {count, plural, one {# model call} other {# model calls}}
agent.noRecent: Hasn't worked on a delivery yet.
agent.canDoIntro: Like at any job: everyone has their own level of access.
agent.policyHelp: “Asks first” pauses the work until you allow it in Waiting on you. New tools from integrations start as “Can't”.

brain.title: Brain
brain.intro: The AI model {name} uses to think.
brain.uses: Uses {primary}, unless the office changed the default in Models & costs.
brain.usesWithFallback: Uses {primary} and, if it fails, {fallback}, unless the office changed the default in Models & costs.
brain.fallback: Plan B, if the main one fails

models.title: Models & costs
models.intro: Connect the AI accounts you already have. Keys are stored only on your server, encrypted, and you pay the provider directly.

providerInfo.openrouter: Hundreds of models with one key

models.tiersIntro: Every agent has a profile. Pick the model each profile uses from the providers you connected.
models.budgetNote: Calculated in US dollars, from each model's public price. When the limit is reached, teams pause until you raise it.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: Agents answer with sample text, with no key and no cost. Good for getting to know the flow. Turn it off once you connect a real provider.

workspaceLanguage.title: Office language
workspaceLanguage.body: The language agents talk in, write deliveries in and get their instructions in. Teams hired after a change arrive in that language; teams already here keep the profile they have.

models.keyNote: We test the key before saving it. It never goes back to the browser.
models.modelCount: {count, plural, =0 {no models listed} one {# model} other {# models}}

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: The systems agents can use. Every new tool starts blocked; you unlock it per agent, on their profile.
integrations.github: Read private pull requests and comment on them.
integrations.notion: Export approved deliveries to a page.
integrations.mcpIntro: Connect any system that speaks MCP: CRM, internal database, Jira, Slack… Its tools show up on every agent's profile.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.notionPage: Page to save into (link or ID)
integrations.note: We test it before saving. The token is stored encrypted on the server.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Everything that changed in the office, and who changed it. The 200 most recent entries.

delivery.changes_requested: asked for changes to a delivery

agent.updated: changed an agent's brain or instructions

tool.allowed: allowed a tool to be used

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.headline: Your AI team is already waiting for you.
signIn.pitch: Create your account and Lia, Téo and Bia join your office, ready for your first request.
signIn.footer: Open source and self-hosted. Your data stays with you.
signIn.createSubtitle: It takes less than a minute.
signIn.name: Your name
signIn.namePlaceholder: What the team will call you
signIn.createSubmit: Create account and meet the team

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.userExists: There's already an account with that email. Try signing in.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.

actions.requestSent: Request sent. The team has already started.
actions.changesSent: Changes sent. The team is already on it.
actions.providerConnected: Connected. {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} available.
actions.integrationTools: Connected. Found {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}.
actions.deliveryCancelled: Cancelled. The team stopped working on it.

errors.managerOnly: Only people who manage the office can change this.
errors.noMasterKey: The server has no SQUADAI_MASTER_KEY, so it can't store keys safely.
errors.noMasterKeySecrets: The server has no SQUADAI_MASTER_KEY to store secrets.
errors.budgetFormat: Use an amount in US dollars, like 20.
errors.notionPage: Paste the link or ID of the Notion page where deliveries should go.
errors.urlScheme: The URL needs to start with http:// or https://.
errors.nothingToExport: There's no text to export yet.
errors.connectNotion: Connect Notion in Integrations to export.
errors.notionRefused: Notion refused ({status}). Is the page shared with the integration?
errors.publicDemo: This is a public demo, so it can't store keys or connect to other systems. Run your own copy to do that.

workErrors.prompt_too_short: Tell us a bit more about what you need.
workErrors.unknown_playbook: This team doesn't do that kind of delivery.
workErrors.delivery_not_waiting: This delivery isn't waiting for a decision.
workErrors.approval_decided: This request has already been decided.
workErrors.feedback_too_short: Say what you want to change.
workErrors.delivery_closed: This delivery is already finished or cancelled.
